|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[A Jedi's Plans (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-59-A_Jedis_Plans-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[A Jedi's Plans (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[A Jedi's Plans (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on a site. Nightfall is canceled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to ▼ Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except a sector) not on table. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 21). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[A Jedi's Plans (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “cancelled” for “canceled” and “(except sector)” for “(except a sector)” (it writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “Deploy on a site. Nightfall is cancelled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to deploy Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except sector) not on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1250_59-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
